description: This file contains Python code for querying and monitoring JWST data in the MAST archive, including functions for inventory, keyword retrieval, and plotting, as well as a main execution block to run the monitoring process.

methods.name: instrument_inventory
methods.description: Retrieves count or data for a specified instrument and data product from JWST MAST.

methods.name: instrument_keywords
methods.description: Fetches header keywords for a specified instrument.

methods.name: jwst_inventory
methods.description: Gathers a full inventory of JWST data across specified instruments and data products, optionally plotting results.

methods.name: monitor_mast
methods.description: Main function to perform and plot JWST and CAOM data inventory monitoring.
